name: Grid of status-coded result cards
looks: A headline promises a short, finite set of outcomes; below it, a tidy grid of small cards pops in together, each with a coloured status pill (a different colour and label per card), an example value, and a one-line verdict on what to do with it.
build: Grid cards pop in on a fast stagger (40-60ms between cards, row by row), each `scale 0.92 -> 1` with a touch of overshoot. The status pill's colour is the one distinguishing element per card; the verdict line fades in 80ms after the card lands.
sound: A quick, light pop per card, fast enough that the full grid's arrival reads as one short flourish rather than six separate hits.
prompt: Promise a short, finite set of outcomes in a headline, then pop in a tidy grid of small cards together, each carrying its own coloured status pill, an example value, and a one-line verdict, so the whole taxonomy reads in one glance.
